summary: PTY-over-WebSocket backdoor with Anthropic key harvesting in shipped darwin-arm64 binary
details: The package ships a prebuilt darwin-arm64 Go binary at bin/sxt that links a PTY spawner (github.com/creack/pty) together with a WebSocket client (github.com/coder/websocket) and the pion WebRTC/DTLS/TURN stack, and embeds the hardcoded relay endpoints wss://relay.sextant.top and https://relay.sextant.top/install. This composition creates a remote-driven PTY: bytes arriving from the author-controlled relay can drive an interactive shell on the installer's host. The same binary embeds the Anthropic API key regex "sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}", references CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models, and includes a masked "sk-ant-…(masked)" token label, indicating the binary reads Claude/Anthropic credentials from the installer's configuration and can forward them over the established relay channel. Additional host reconnaissance is present via http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=status,message,country,countryCode,city,timezone,query, which returns public-IP-derived geolocation of the installer. The package.json license field points to https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control, where the repository name self-describes the binary's function.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
